title: Wren and the Safehouse
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Jude Pemberton, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
